bug.actual_behavior: Whenever any workflow unit is cached, the checker requires templates/checkpoint_helpers.R and emits unsafe-checkpoint-helper for a valid helper stored under scripts/helpers.
evidence: [ERROR] unsafe-checkpoint-helper: templates/checkpoint_helpers.R: cached workflows need a regular in-project copy of the Skill checkpoint helper
bug.expected_behavior: The checker should read a configurable in-project checkpoint helper path from config or the analysis plan and validate that regular file.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Create an analysis plan with at least one cached unit.
Store checkpoint_helpers.R under scripts/helpers and update all runtime references.
Run check_analysis_workflow.py with the plan in strict mode.
bug.summary: Workflow checker hardcodes checkpoint helper under the templates directory
bug.workaround: Keep the project helper under scripts/helpers for clear directory ownership and document this single checker incompatibility; do not duplicate the helper into the theme directory.
